question: The book titled 'Farthest Field' has been authored by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raghu Karnad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Raghu Karnad’s book **Farthest Field** is the intersection of larger historical events with the personal.
 
• Beginning from Calicut, it follows his mother’s father, Kodandera, and his two Parsi brothers-in-law, Godrej and Manek, who went to war in different armed services.
 
• Kodandera as an Army doctor, Godrej with the Bombay Sappers and Manek in the Royal Indian Air Force.
 
• Farthest Field was awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar** for a writer in English in 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raghu Karnad:**

 
 
• **​**He is a recipient of the **Windham–Campbell Literature Prize** for Non-Fiction.
 
• Other work -** Everybody's Friend**.
